liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Eyes Of The World** (3 reviews): Reviewer recommends the show chiefly for its Eyes; Eyes flowing into Foolish Heart is singled out as very nice [24][25][27]
- **To Lay Me Down** (2 reviews): First performance since Brent died; Jerry's singing was heartfelt and emotional; Called very powerful and the main reason to get the show [22][25]
- **Jam** (2 reviews): Reviewer finds the Jam incredible, with Garcia stretching out; An amazing jam after Foolish Heart, before Drums, stands out [29][32]
- **Mississippi Half-Step Uptown Toodleloo** (1 review): Hornsby takes a solo in Half-Step [30]
- **New Minglewood Blues** (1 review): Hornsby takes a solo; about 3:45 in he has the crowd in his hand [30]
- **Desolation Row** (1 review): First-set Minglewood, Desolation Row, Lay Me Down and Promised Land are described as sleek and mean [26]
- **Estimated Prophet** (1 review): Reviewer likes the Eyes, Estimated, Foolish placement in the second set [32]
- **Foolish Heart** (1 review): Reviewer cherishes the show for its upbeat Foolish Heart [23]

## Setlist highlights

- **SSDD**: back after 124 archived shows (585 days); rare: 5 archived performances [34]

## The recordings

- **gd1990-09-18.124767.AT835.Fix.laurentis.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 20 songs; 184 min [1]
- **gd90-09-18.schoeps-fob.sacks.9772.sbeok.shnf**: source not stated; 19 songs; 186 min; rated 4.6/5 by 10 [5]. Said about its sound: Reviewer wishes the sound of this recording were a little better; Recording sounds like MSG itself, with a quiet crowd audible [26][29]
- **gd90-09-18.sbd.miller.12885.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 18 songs; 175 min; rated 3.65/5 by 20 [8]. Said about its sound: Good recording with slight hiss; levels somewhat muddy, especially during Eyes; Hornsby seems low in the mix; Sounds excellent, though the reviewer suspects it is a matrix mix [23][30]
- **gd1990-09-18.sbd.miller.tetzeli.fix-12885.35162.reflac.flac16**: soundboard; 18 songs; 174 min [10]
- **gd1990-09-18.mtx.hansokolow.96156.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 17 songs; 185 min [16]

## Around the show

- Hornsby stays closely on Garcia's lines while Garcia answers with precise, cutting notes [26]
- Reviewer attended all the Garden shows, mostly on the floor; the band missed Brent while Vince and Bruce explored [29]
- Usher Barry kept the crowd as quiet as he could and covered the mic stand [11]
- Tapers befriended the head security guard and ran him a DAT copy each night [16]
- Reviewer saw three MSG shows and rated the September 20 show best of the three [22]
- Called the less-publicized MSG night; its Other One is judged better than the other MSG Other One [27]
- Reviewer says the band clearly stepped up at the Garden run after Brent's death [28]
- Hornsby seemed absent here compared with the rest of the run, though better speakers revealed him [32]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1990-09-18.124767.AT835.Fix.laurentis.flac16**: taped by M.Laurentus; transferred by M.Laurentus; source: Taper: M. Laurentus; Loge/Taper Section Sec 56D,Row A,Seat 12; AT835B's- AT 8202’s-SONY TCD-5M-Cassette-Tascam DR-5 Line In-CD Wave- Flac [1]. Also: Source is an AT835 recording, fixed by laurentis, in 16-bit FLAC [1]
- **gd90-09-18.schoeps-fob.sacks.9772.sbeok.shnf**: source: MAD(FOB Schoeps)>D>CD >WAV>SHN. [5]
- **gd90-09-18.sbd.miller.12885.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD>Cm>Dat>CD>WAV>SHN [8]
- **gd1990-09-18.sbd.miller.tetzeli.fix-12885.35162.reflac.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller and Bill Tetzeli; source: SBD->Cm->Dat->CD->Cool Edit Pro->CD>EAC>SHN [10]. Also: Soundboard transfer: gaps and cuts removed in Cool Edit Pro, discs normalized to 98%, and CD overlap deleted; An audience recording from archive.org was used to patch a couple of seconds at the end of Picasso Moon [10]
- **gd1990-09-18.mtx.hansokolow.96156.flac16**: transferred by hansokolow; source: Matrix mix (SBD/AUD) [16]. Also: Matrix by hansokolow in ProTools; Dave Brotman taped front-of-board, Section 2, row 15, with Schoeps MK4/CMC3 microphones; A secondary 20th-row B&K4011 DAT source patched two dropouts in Promised Land and two in Eyes [16]
